messages:
mara (docs): FYI I opened a docs PR that adds an 'MTU & offload guidance' section for private/VPC installs (covers jumbo frames, host NIC tuning, and container runtimes). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4921
otto (eng-net): Nice — can you include exact sysctl + ip link commands we recommend? Teams always ask what to change for 9000 MTU vs default 1500.
mara (docs): Current draft snippet: ```bash
# set host MTU to 9000 on eth0
ip link set dev eth0 mtu 9000
# persist via sysctl for dpdk-like drivers (example)
cat >> /etc/sysctl.d/99-redwood-mtu.conf <<'EOF'
# enable large receive offload (example)
net.core.rmem_max = 26214400
net.core.wmem_max = 26214400
net.ipv4.tcp_rmem = 4096 87380 26214400
net.ipv4.tcp_wmem = 4096 65536 26214400
EOF
sysctl --system
```

zuri (eng-install): Add a note for container runtimes: for containerd/Kubernetes you must set the node's CNI and kubelet to match MTU. Example for Calico: `calicoctl node --mtu 9000` or set `veth_mtu` in the CNI config. Also call out cloud-init examples for persistent network config.
felix (infra): Also mention NIC offloads: `ethtool -K eth0 gro on gso on tso on` and note that some virtual NICs (vhost, virtio) do offloading automatically — include a troubleshooting hint to run `ethtool -k` to inspect.
vanya (security): For air-gapped installs, please include guidance that jumbo frames need end-to-end support (sync host, customer switch config). Add a short advisory: if packets are dropped during sealed bundle transfer, prefer rsync with smaller MTU or use scp with -C to compress.
mara (docs): Good points — I'll add ethtool commands and CNI hints. Also including a short 'why not always 9000' blurb: increased latency for small messages, MTU mismatch risks, and HSM gRPC channels can show fragment issues when MTU mismatches.
otto (eng-net): For HSM and KMS nodes, call out that some HSM appliances have fixed MTU or require jumbo frames disabled. We should put a clear bullet: "Verify HSM appliance docs before changing MTU on HSM-connected hosts."
zuri (eng-install): For installer hooks, suggest a preflight check that tests end-to-end MTU with ping + size: `ping -M do -s 8972 <peer>` and fallback instructions to temporarily set smaller MSS for TCP via `iptables --set-mss` or `sysctl net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1`.
mara (docs): I'll add a small preflight checklist: 1) check `ip link`, 2) ping large packet test, 3) check CNI/veth MTU, 4) verify HSM docs, 5) run sealed bundle transfer test.
felix (infra): One docs nit: when showing commands, prefer to include both RHEL and Debian examples for persistent net config (e.g., NetworkManager vs /etc/network/interfaces). Also mention `nmcli` example.
vanya (security): Security note: if recommending `ethtool -K` changes in docs, add a warning that offload toggles may interfere with some kernel packet filters (we should advise a staging test window).
mara (docs): Will add the warnings and split examples by distro. Also will include a one-liner to test MD5/sha256 of transferred bundles in the same section: ```bash
# on airgap sync host
sha256sum sealed-bundle.tar.gz > sealed-bundle.tar.gz.sha256
# on target host after transfer
openssl dgst -sha256 sealed-bundle.tar.gz | awk '{print $2}' > local.sha256
[ "$(cat local.sha256)" = "$(cut -d' ' -f1 sealed-bundle.tar.gz.sha256)" ] || echo 'checksum mismatch'
```
otto (eng-net): Can you also include a short blurb about MTU for UDP vs TCP — e.g., RTP/video or monitoring UDP flows can be hit differently by fragmentation.
mara (docs): Will do. CI-bot: PR #4921 link-checker: 2 broken links (CNI doc anchor moved, Calico example path updated), linter: minor markdown style warnings.
mara (docs): I'll fix anchors and split the Calico example into an inline snippet and a link to calico docs. Anyone want to review the distro persistence examples? I aim to merge after CI is green.
zuri (eng-install): I'll skim and approve if the examples match what we use in the installer hooks.
felix (infra): Quick +1 on the approach; add a short reference to our internal perf team MTU tests (internal link).
vanya (security): +1 for including the HSM advisory.
mara (docs): Thanks all — iterating now, will paste final PR link here when merged. :rocket:
